entries.title: Thinking in Systems
entries.author: Donella Meadows
entries.note: The best primer on systems thinking. Changed how I approach complex problems at work.

entries.title: The Design of Everyday Things
entries.author: Don Norman
entries.note: Foundational for anyone building products. Makes you see affordances everywhere.

entries.title: Storytelling with Data
entries.author: Cole Nussbaumer Knaflic
entries.note: Practical guide to making data presentations that actually communicate. I reference this constantly.

entries.title: The Mythical Man-Month
entries.author: Frederick Brooks
entries.note: Timeless essays on software engineering and why adding people to a late project makes it later.

entries.title: How to Do Great Work
entries.author: Paul Graham
entries.note: A long essay on the common patterns behind exceptional work across fields. Worth revisiting yearly.
